observations: Black fat tire bicycle with bright green rims and frame accents
Very wide knobby tires on front and rear wheels
Front suspension fork and disc brakes visible
Rear derailleur and multi-speed drivetrain present

"AMERICAN BRAND" watermark across lower portion of photo 0
Bike photographed indoors on tiled floor against white paneled wall

risks.risk: Bike may not be rideable: brakes, gears, tire air retention, or wheel trueness could be faulty
risks.proof: short video of the bike being ridden, or brakes squeezed and gears shifted, plus close-ups of tire sidewalls and rims

risks.risk: Frame may have cracks or damage not visible from this single angle
risks.proof: close-up photos of all frame joints, especially head tube, bottom bracket, and rear dropouts

risks.risk: Item may be used rather than newly imported as claimed
risks.proof: original purchase documents, customs papers, or close-up of tires/components showing no wear

proof_requests: Video of the bicycle being ridden or at least brakes squeezed and gears shifted
Close-up photos of frame joints for cracks
Close-up of tires to assess wear and age
Any import or purchase documents supporting the newly imported claim
response.reason: The photos clearly show a fat tire bicycle, so it can be valued at its worst case (non-working, used) pending proof of function and import status.
